claims.evidence: The InfluxDB 1.x key concepts, schema design and storage engine pages were read from a partial clone of influxdata/docs-v2; InfluxDB itself was not run. The compression comparison is the author's Python computation on simulated data (zlib, not InfluxDB's encoders) on 2026-10-18.

claims.claim_vi: A point has a measurement, tag set, field set and timestamp and is identified by its series and timestamp; a series is the collection of points sharing a measurement, tag set and field key; tags are indexed and fields are not, so filtering on a field value scans every value.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of influxdata/docs-v2 at commit 3c30e2b5ddcfd1320a745eafee6fb9afccb7e97c.

claims.claim_vi: Tags holding highly variable information (unique IDs, hashes, random strings) create many series; high series cardinality is a primary driver of high memory usage, so store such values in fields.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of influxdata/docs-v2 at commit 3c30e2b5ddcfd1320a745eafee6fb9afccb7e97c.

claims.claim_vi: The storage engine writes to a WAL and an in-memory cache, then snapshots to TSM files, which store sorted, compressed series data in a columnar format.
claims.section: The InfluxDB storage engine and the Time-Structured Merge Tree
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of influxdata/docs-v2 at commit 3c30e2b5ddcfd1320a745eafee6fb9afccb7e97c.

claims.claim_vi: Computed on one simulated day (a point every 10 s at two locations, temperature and humidity): 17,280 points form 4 series; as line-protocol text 1,240,743 bytes and 70,217 after zlib; as per-series delta-encoded columns 552,960 bytes and 14,064 after zlib; a unique reading id as a tag would give 34,560 series.
claims.verified_by: The author ran this Python computation on 2026-10-18 with seeded random data; zlib stands in for InfluxDB's type-specific encoders.

claims.claim_vi: The source states that a TSDB looks like a relational table to users but the weather table is stored in 4 TSMs in the format [Measurement, Tag, Field Name], allowing fast aggregation by time and tags, and lists market data, server metrics, APM, network and sensor data as uses. The lesson does not adopt the 4 TSMs wording: per the InfluxDB docs these are 4 series, and a TSM file holds many series (see source_deviations).

design_notes_vi: Bốn phần của một điểm, ba bước thành series, ba số đo và tính. Không dùng ảnh nguồn; dữ liệu thời tiết là giả lập.
source_deviations: The source says the table is stored in 4 TSMs; per the InfluxDB docs these are 4 series stored in TSM files, which hold many series each.
The lesson adds tag versus field indexing, the series-cardinality trap and a compression comparison; it drops the source's list of use cases.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
